data.name: Hishamun
data.gender_notes: Hishamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who conveys good news, gives happiness and is a source of wisdom and intelligence. The name Hishamun carries the meaning “Giver of Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hishamun usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the ability to bring joy and wisdom to others, as well as being a source of positive news and inspiration
data.etymology: Hishamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hishamun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: هشامون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني: ملك الحكمة و الشجاعة و الكرم
in_arabic.long_meaning: هشامون هو اسم من أصل عربي، مشتق من الجذر ح-ش-م، يُستخدم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك الملكة الحكمة والمужة والشجاعة والكرم. يُعتبر هاشمون اسمًا مرغوبًا في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالسعة البالغة في المعرفة والشجاعة والكرم. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في بعض الأحاديث النبوية الشريفة، حيث يُروى عن النبي محمد (صلى الله عليه وسلم) أنه قال: "هشامون: ملك الحكمة و الشجاعة و الكرم". يُعتبر هاشمون اسمًا شائعًا في الثقافة العربية والإسلامية، حيث يُستخدم في العديد من الأسماء الشخصية في مختلف البلدان العربية والإسلامية.

in_english.name: Hishamun
in_english.long_meaning: Hishamun is an Arabic name derived from the root H-Sh-M, meaning wisdom, courage, and generosity. In Islamic tradition, Hishamun is a name associated with wisdom, courage, and generosity. The name is mentioned in some Hadiths, where Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Hishamun: the king of wisdom, courage, and generosity." Hishamun is a popular name in many Muslim cultures, symbolizing the qualities of wisdom, courage, and generosity.

In a world where negativity and hate often prevail, names with such meaning as Hishamun remind us of the importance of spreading positivity and optimism within our families and communities.

This spiritual significance is particularly noteworthy as it symbolizes the power of faith and optimism, which can lead to significant spiritual growth.
